question: I moved out of my house last year and rented it out. Do I need to tell you something?
notes: CITIZEN VOICE. Written deliberately in the register a resident uses at the counter, not statutory language. Added 2026-08-03 after discovering the existing suites were phrased semi-statutorily and therefore could not detect the citizen-phrasing retrieval defect at all — the one clerk case that caught it did so by accident. Tests that colloquial 'moved out and rented it' reaches the PRE rescission duty — a missed rescission is a real revenue and penalty problem.
